data.title: HiProMine Share Block Trade Ends Presumed Agreement Between Key Investors
data.description:

data.description:

data.title: Manulife Financial Sets Terms for US$750 Million Subordinated Notes Due 2041
data.description:
An update from Manulife Financial ( (TSE:MFC) ) is now available.

On September 11, 2026, Manulife Financial Corporation filed a Form 6-K in the United States to report a Second Supplemental Indenture under its existing subordinated indenture first established in 2017. The filing reflects Manulife’s ongoing use of U.S. and Canadian trustees to structure subordinated debt offerings that qualify under Canadian capital rules, underscoring the company’s active management of Tier 2 capital and long-term funding.

The Second Supplemental Indenture, dated September 11, 2026, establishes a new series of 6.146% subordinated notes due 2041 with an initial aggregate principal amount of US$750 million. These notes, which feature a reset of the interest rate in 2036 and the possibility of issuing additional fungible notes, further embed Manulife’s access to long-dated subordinated financing and may strengthen its regulatory capital profile and flexibility for future issuances.
